legacy_naming.description: Keep its entity ids (e.g. `sensor.total_dc_power`) so your existing automations and dashboards keep working unchanged -- recommended. Uncheck to switch to this integration's modern, device-prefixed ids instead (e.g. `sensor.sh10rt_total_dc_power`), which will break any references to the old ids. **This choice cannot be changed later** -- remove and re-add the integration to change it.{legacy_warning}
